name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
jobs:
  mutation-plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - run: echo plan
  mutation-python:
    needs: [mutation-plan]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      # one leg of the runner
      - run: python3 scripts/mutation_python.py run --shard 0/1
  mutation-python-release:
    needs: [mutation-plan]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - run: python3 scripts/mutation_python.py run --shard 1/2
  mutation-verdict:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - run: echo verdict
